newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dong Won, Daesung limit-up.
newsitem.headline: Dong Won, Daesung limit-up.

text.p: Shares of coal miners Dong Won Co Ltd and Daesung Resources Co went limit-up on Wednesday on government plans to develop a mining area into a resort town.
Dong Won rose 4,100 won to its daily limit of 56,500, and Daesung Resources also went limit-up, rising 8,500 won to 115,500.
"Those shares related to the development plan are likely to rise for the time being," said Kim Heung-shik of Hyundai Securities.
The companies are expected to benefit from a rise in the area's land price.

On Tuesday the Ministry of Construction and Transportation said a total of 2.54 trillion won would be invested by 2005 to develop a coal mining region in Kangwon Province into a leisure town, including ski trails, hotels and golf courses.
